source_title: Group 1 Automotive Named to Forbes' World's Top Companies for Women 2026 - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
First-time recognition reflects independent survey of approximately 140,000 women across 61 countries
HOUSTON , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Group 1 Automotive, Inc. (NYSE: GPI ) today announced it has been named to the World's Top Companies for Women 2026, presented by Forbes in partnership with Statista, a global market research and industry ranking provider. This marks the Company's first appearance on the list.
According to Forbes and Statista, the ranking draws on independent, anonymous surveys of approximately 140,000 women in 61 countries, generating more than 800,000 data points. Final rankings reflect several components, including employer brand, public opinion regarding gender equality, and leadership research.
"This recognition belongs to the women across our 251 dealerships and to the leaders, many of them women, who build teams where they can grow," said Daryl Kenningham, President and CEO of Group 1 Automotive. "Our customers are making purchase and service decisions as households, and women are frequently leading those decisions. A workforce that looks like our customers serves them better. That's good for our people, and it's good business."
Group 1 operates as a national network of local businesses, and remains focused on delivering a workplace that attracts, develops, and retains talent at every level, from technicians and sales consultants to store and regional leadership. Women also hold 40 percent of the seats on the Company's Board of Directors.
The full list is available at Forbes.com .
Group 1 owns and operates 256 automotive dealerships, 319 franchises, and 33 collision centers in the United States and the United Kingdom that offer 38 brands of automobiles. Through its dealerships and omni-channel platform, the Company sells new and used cars and light trucks; arranges related vehicle financing; sells service contracts; provides automotive maintenance and repair services; and sells vehicle parts. Learn more at Group1Auto.com .
